zh.explain: 春来花开辉映门庭，招贤车来时财宝随至。如果龙门涌起波浪，就会身化为龙，像一声春雷名扬天下。
divination: 若从政走仕途，能够得到职位；若是贫穷则可获得财宝，谋划展望未来的事业，也可以称心如意。这是所有卦中第一位的好卦。
items: 此签所昭示的神机是从心所欲，万事都吉祥顺利。
zh.summary: 此卦上朝见帝之象。所祈求之事非常吉祥。

verse: On the balcony, the flowers bloom as Spring arrives.
Treasures brought by vessels from miles away.
Once over the dragon’s gate, the waves surged thrice,
Shakes the earth like a sudden clap of thunder.
interpretation: This is like receiving endless wealth.
Everything will work out for the best.
This Lot is the best of all.
meaning: An appointment conferred by the emperor (someone in higher authority).
Everything will be very auspicious and favorable.
en.explain: Spring flowers bloom and brighten your door, and a chariot arrives, bringing loads of treasure. If a big wave surges at the dragon's gate, you will swiftly rise like a dragon, like a clap of thunder that brings you fame to the world.
divination: If you go into politics or government service, you can get a position; if you are poor you will receive treasure, and all plans for your future All things will work out to be the best, this is the best lot of all.
items: Reveals the divine sign that you can do whatever you wish, and everything will be auspicious and smooth.
